basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old DIY enthusiast from the Midwest, balancing my time between work as a junior graphic designer and exploring creative home improvement projects. I love diving into new hobbies and sharing my progress with the community. When I'm not working or DIY-ing, you'll find me immersed in RPGs or experimenting with new scents. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my evenings browsing Reddit or playing games. I usually log on after dinner around 7 PM until late.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in graphic design, I have a keen eye for aesthetics and functionality. My knowledge of home improvement is largely self-taught, driven by a passion for creating unique spaces. I also have a growing interest in indie games and fragrances, which I explore through online communities and discussions.
